source_document: Counter Copilot v0.1 Evaluation Framework (Synthetic Benchmark Dataset, 30 cases)

failure_patterns.description: The AI inferring a length of "8 feet" just because "2x4" was requested without a length, or assuming "SPF" when "wood" is stated.
Failing to capture mid-sentence corrections (e.g., "Need 50, actually make it 60") and outputting the first encountered number.
Confusing linear feet (LF), square feet (SQFT), and piece counts (EA), especially when terms like "bunk", "lift", or "unit" are used by contractors.
Dropping hardware or concrete items when a request is predominantly lumber-focused.

failure_patterns.failure_mode: False ConfidenceAssigning a 100% confidence score to a parsed item when the grade or treatment is ambiguous.

scoring_rubric.scoring_rule: +1 for correct intent (Quote Request, General Inquiry, Non-Material).
+1 for every distinct physical material identified. -1 for missed items.
+1 per correctly extracted field matching exact source evidence.
+2 for explicitly outputting null or MISSING when a spec is omitted.
-10 (Auto-Fail) for outputting a dimension, species, or grade not explicitly stated in the text.
+2 for generating an employee warning on conflicting data (e.g., "10" vs "twenty").

cases.email_text: Need 50 pieces of 2x4x8 SPF standard grade.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 50, Dim: 2x4x8, Species: SPF, Grade: Standard. (Evidence: literal string matches)
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None

cases.email_text: Quote me on 100 sheets of 7/16 OSB.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Unit explicitly marked as "sheets".

cases.email_text: Can I get a price on 20 2x6x12 treated boards?
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None

cases.email_text: Send over 40 bags of 80lb Quikrete.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 40, Mat: Quikrete, Weight: 80lb, Unit: bags.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None

cases.email_text: I need 200 linear feet of 1x4 primed pine trim.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 200, Unit: linear feet (LF), Dim: 1x4, Species: pine, Treatment: primed.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: Ensure pricing is calculated per LF, not per piece.

cases.email_text: Send me some 2x4x10s for tomorrow.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: MISSING: Qty. Warning: "some" cannot be resolved to a number.

cases.email_text: Need 30 2x6s.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: MISSING: Length. Do not assume 8ft.

cases.email_text: Quote for 50 pieces of pine.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: MISSING: Dimensions.

cases.email_text: We need a bunk of 1/2 inch plywood.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 1 bunk, Dim: 1/2 inch, Mat: plywood.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: "Bunk" piece count varies by mill/distributor. Requires employee mapping.

cases.email_text: Give me your best price on 2x8 floor joists.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: MISSING: Qty, Length, Species.

cases.email_text: I need 50 of the 2x4x8s, wait actually make it 60.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: Explicit correction detected. Evidence must map to "60".

cases.email_text: Can you send twenty (10) 4x4x10 treated posts?
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: CONFLICT: Qty. Text says "twenty", numeral says "10". Flag for employee review.

cases.email_text: Need 2x6x12s. No, scratch that, I need 16 footers.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: Length corrected from 12 to 16.

cases.email_text: Order 500 feet of 2x4.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: Check if contractor meant 500 LF or 500 pieces.

cases.email_text: Need 100 2x4x92-5/8 precut studs.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None. Must precisely extract fractional dimensions without math errors.

cases.email_text: Gimme a lift of plywod 3/4 CDX.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 1 lift, Mat: plywood, Dim: 3/4, Grade: CDX.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Spelling "plywod" mapped to plywood. "Lift" requires piece-count mapping.

cases.email_text: Need 40 pt 2x4x8s.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Evidence for treatment is the abbreviation "pt".

cases.email_text: Send 50 sticks of #4 rebar 20ft.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 50, Unit: sticks, Mat: rebar, Dim: #4 x 20ft.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Must recognize "sticks" as pieces.

cases.email_text: Need 20 sheets of half inch zip.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 20, Unit: sheets, Dim: 1/2 inch, Mat: zip (Zip System).
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None. Maps "zip" to Zip System sheathing.

cases.email_text: Drop off 50 five-quarter by six sixteen foot cedar decking.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Qty: 50, Dim: 5/4x6x16, Species: cedar, Mat: decking.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Translates spoken fractions ("five-quarter") to "5/4".

cases.email_text: Need 50 2x4x8 SPF, 20 sheets 7/16 OSB, and 2 boxes of 3-inch sinkers.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Line 1: Qty 50, 2x4x8 SPF. Line 2: Qty 20, 7/16 OSB. Line 3: Qty 2 boxes, 3-inch sinkers.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None. Must output array of 3 distinct material objects.

cases.email_text: 100 2x6x10 SYP #1. Also 50 LU24 joist hangers.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Line 1: Qty 100, 2x6x10, SYP, #1. Line 2: Qty 50, LU24 joist hangers.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Recognizes hardware sku "LU24".

cases.email_text: Send 40 bags portland and 100 1/2x10 anchor bolts.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Line 1: Qty 40, Portland cement. Line 2: Qty 100, 1/2x10 anchor bolts.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None.

cases.email_text: Need framing pkg for attached plan. Send 100 2x4x8s to start.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: Warning: Refers to an attached plan. Extracted only the explicitly requested starting material.

cases.email_text: 40 2x8x16 PT and 10 rolls of tyvek housewrap.
cases.expected_extractions_and_evidence: Line 1: Qty 40, 2x8x16, PT. Line 2: Qty 10, Tyvek housewrap, Unit: rolls.
cases.expected_ambiguities_warnings: None.
